paragraphs: Costco Wholesale Corporation is an American multinational corporation that operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores. As of 2025, Costco is the third-largest retailer in the world, and as of August 2024, the world's largest retailer of beef, poultry, organic produce, and wine, with just under a third of American consumers regularly shopping at Costco warehouses. As of 2026, Costco is ranked 12th on the Fortune 500 rankings of the largest United States corporations by total revenue.

Costco's worldwide headquarters are in Issaquah, Washington, an eastern suburb of Seattle. Its Kirkland Signature house label is named after its former location in Kirkland, another eastern Seattle suburb. The company opened its first warehouse (the chain's term for its retail outlets) in Seattle in 1983. Through mergers, Costco's corporate history dates back to 1976, when its former competitor Price Club was founded in San Diego, California.

Costco originally began with a wholesale business model aimed at enrolling businesses as members, and later began enrolling individual consumers and selling products intended for them, including its own private-label brand. As of March 2026, Costco operates 924 warehouses worldwide, with 85% of them being in North America (United States, Canada, and Mexico).

people.name: Ron M. Vachris
people.title: President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Has been a director since February 2022. Previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer from February 2022 to December 2023 and Executive Vice President of Merchandising from June 2016 to January 2022.
people.quote: Ron M. Vachris | President and Chief Executive Officer. Mr. Vachris has been a director since February 2022.

people.name: Gary Millerchip
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of The Kroger Co. from April 2019 to February 2024. Before that, he was Chief Executive Officer of Kroger Personal Finance since July 2010.
people.quote: Gary Millerchip | Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

people.name: Caton Frates
people.title: Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Warehouse Operations, U.S. and Mexico
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, Southwest Division from 2022 to February 2026. He was Senior Vice President, Los Angeles Region from 2015 to May 2022.
people.quote: Caton Frates | Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Warehouse Operations, U.S. and Mexico.

people.name: Jim C. Klauer
people.title: Executive Vice President
people.bio: Served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Northern Division from 2018 to August 2026 and Senior Vice President, Non-Foods and E-commerce Merchandise from 2013 to January 2018. His retirement is effective October 30, 2026.
people.quote: Jim C. Klauer | Executive Vice President. Mr. Klauer was Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Northern Division from 2018 to August 2026

people.name: Yoram Rubanenko
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Eastern Division
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President and General Manager, Southeast Region from 2013 to September 2021. He was Vice President, Regional Operations Manager for the Northeast Region from 1998 to 2013.
people.quote: Yoram Rubanenko | Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Eastern Division.

people.name: John Sullivan
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Has been General Counsel since 2016 and Corporate Secretary since 2010. He has been an executive officer since 2021.
people.quote: John Sullivan | Executive Vice President, General Counsel & Corporate Secretary.

people.name: Claudine Adamo
people.title: Executive Vice President, Administration
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Merchandising from 2022 to March 2026. She was Senior Vice President, Non-Foods from 2018 to February 2022 and Vice President, Non-Foods from 2013 to 2018.
people.quote: Claudine Adamo | Executive Vice President, Administration. Ms. Adamo was Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Merchandising from 2022 to March 2026

people.name: Pierre Riel
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, International Division
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President, Country Manager, Canada from 2019 to March 2022. He was Senior Vice President, Eastern Canada Region from 2001 to 2019.
people.quote: Pierre Riel | Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, International Division.

people.name: Javier Polit
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Information and Digital Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Chief Information Officer for Mondelez International from 2022 to 2024 and for The Procter & Gamble Company from 2017 to 2022. Before that, he was Group Chief Information Officer for The Coca-Cola Company from 2007 to 2017.
people.quote: Javier Polit | Executive Vice President, Chief Information and Digital Officer.

people.name: Teresa Jones
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Global Depots and Traffic
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President, Depot Operations from August 2022 to July 2024. She was Vice President, Depot Operations from 2018 to 2022.
people.quote: Teresa Jones | Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Global Depots and Traffic.

people.name: W. Richard Wilcox
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, Southwest Division

people.quote: W. Richard Wilcox | Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, Southwest Division.

people.name: Sarah George
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Merchandising
people.bio: Previously served as Senior Vice President, Merchandising - Foods and Sundries from 2023 to March 2026. She was Senior Vice President, Fresh Foods from 2019 to 2023.
people.quote: Sarah George | Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Merchandising.

people.name: Adam Self
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, Northern Division

people.quote: Adam Self | Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, Northern Division.

people.title: Director

people.name: Jeffrey S. Raikes
people.title: Director
people.bio: Co-founded the Raikes Foundation and served as CEO of the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation from 2008 to 2014. He held several positions at Microsoft from 1981 to 2008, including President of the Business Division from 2005 to 2008.
people.quote: Jeffrey S. Raikes has been a director of the Company since December 2008.

people.name: Gina M. Raimondo
people.title: Director Candidate
people.bio: A distinguished fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, she served as Secretary of Commerce from 2021 to 2025. Previously, she served as Governor of Rhode Island from 2015 to 2021 and General Treasurer of Rhode Island from 2011 to 2015.
people.quote: Gina M. Raimondo has been nominated to stand for election at the 2026 annual meeting.

people.name: John W. Stanton
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chairs Trilogy Equity Partners and First Avenue Entertainment LLLP, the owner of the Seattle Mariners. He founded and served as Chairman and CEO of Western Wireless Corporation and is currently a director of Microsoft.
people.quote: John W. Stanton has been a director of the Company since October 2015.

people.name: Ron M. Vachris
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, President and Director
people.bio: Has served as Chief Executive Officer and President since January 2024, after serving as President and Chief Operating Officer from February 2022 to January 2024. His earlier roles included Executive Vice President of Merchandising and Senior Vice President of Real Estate Development.
people.quote: Ron M. Vachris has been a director of the Company since February 2022, and Chief Executive Officer and President since January 2024.

people.name: Mary Agnes (Maggie) Wilderotter
people.title: Director
people.bio: Serves as Chairman of the Board at DocuSign and provides senior advisor work for several private equity and venture firms. She previously served as CEO of Frontier Communications from 2004 to 2015 and as interim CEO of DocuSign from June through October 2022.
people.quote: Mary Agnes (Maggie) Wilderotter has been a director of the Company since October 2015.
